title: Waubun Secondary School high schoolers post 2nd highest science MCA participation for 2024-25
text:
Waubun Secondary School high schoolers post 2nd highest science MCA participation for 2024-25
L. O. Perez
At Waubun Secondary School, high school students had the second highest participation rate for the science segment of the 2024-25 MCA, as reported by the Minnesota Department of Education.
Out of 72 students who completed that part of the test at Waubun Secondary School, 23 were high school enrollees.
According to the test standards, 39% of those high school students demonstrated proficiency in science.
The MCA and the Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) serve as the state’s tools for assessing student achievement in accordance with Minnesota’s academic standards and to fulfill state and federal legislative requirements. These exams assess math, reading, and science depending on grade level. While most students complete the MCA, the Alt MCA is available for eligible students receiving special education services.
Overall proficiency rates on Minnesota's MCA assessments have dropped compared to pre-pandemic figures, as detailed by Minnesota's Report Card. Math proficiency decreased by more than 7% from 2019, while reading proficiency is down nearly 5%.
| Grade | # of Students Tested | Proficiency in science |
|---|---|---|
| 8th | 49 | 14% |
| HS | 23 | 39% |
Information for this article is sourced from the Minnesota Department of Education. The underlying source data is available here.
